source: VBB fare zones Berlin A/B/C. A: area inside the S-Bahn ring track (S41 geometry from network.json). B: Berlin state area (OSM relation 62422, boundaries.json) minus A. C: union of the municipalities and Ortsteile marked B-C in the VBB Gemeinde- und Bahnhofsverzeichnis mit Wabenzuordnung (VBB-Tarif: Alle Zielorte 2026, Redaktionsschluss 9.12.2025, https://www.vbb.de/fileadmin/user_upload/VBB/Dokumente/Tickets-Abonnements/vbb-tarif-alle-zielorte.pdf), Wohnplatz Klein-Ziethen approximated by a Voronoi split, minus Berlin, simplified to about 20 m. Boundaries (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, via Nominatim. Station zones follow the polygons, ring stations are A, exceptions as listed.

exceptions.900026202: U Kaiserdamm lies about 200 m outside the ring track; VBB Bahnhofsverzeichnis lists 'Kaiserdamm U' in Wabe 5555 (Berlin A)
